name: slim-proof
description: The ADR 0366 Phase-1 PROOF distribution (not a product SKU): excludes the sales cluster + commerce to demonstrate tree-shaken exclusion, closure validation, and the honesty gates. Exclude-list semantics are Phase-1-only; Phase 2's bundle catalog brings include-based manifests (the licensing-safe direction). `kicktodo-commerce` is excluded too — it hard-depends on the excluded `commerce`, so the dependsOn closure requires it (ADR 0414 KickTodo landed after this fixture; keeping the closure honest).
